guitar.notes: Kerry King's B.C. Rich Warlocks (and later signature B.C. Rich/ESP models) and Jeff Hanneman's similar B.C. Rich guitars are extremely well documented in thrash metal history.

tone.target: tight thrash crunch with dry bite and dark low mids
tone.profile: tight thrash crunch with dry bite and dark low mids
tone.summary: A punchy signal chain utilizing a Boost/OD pedal for attack definition, followed by a powerful UK 45 amp model and the UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve dry, mid-focused thrash crunch.
